game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, giant bats strike the ore lift, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ore lift from giant bats in Hidden Spring: keep the digits meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: digits drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Hidden Spring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while digits > 0.
